name: B10-0325/2026 (S&D) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Belarus for jailing Aliaksandra Pulinovich, a teenager sentenced to over 10 years on political grounds, and calls for her release and that of all political prisoners in Belarus. It asks Belarus to respect children's rights, give detainees access to doctors, lawyers and family, and stop mistreatment. It also asks the European Union to support prisoners and their families and to consider more sanctions.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- The demands target Belarus's authorities and affect political prisoners there.
- Next, the resolution is sent to European Union bodies and others; no action is guaranteed.
